title: Android Process Analyzer verbose capture (schema_version 3.0-verbose)
description: json/verbose.json: the analyzer report plus every raw evidence file captured from the device, inline. Each evidence item keeps the exact adb command, exit code, byte count and SHA-256 of the raw bytes. The content field is the UTF-8 decoding of those bytes, with invalid sequences replaced; the SHA-256 identifies the raw bytes.

analyzer_repo_commit.description: Git commit of the analyzer used for the capture; null if git was unavailable.

report.description: Same document as json/report.json (validated by schemas/analyzer-report.schema.json).
